scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Assistance for Setting Up Farmer Support Centers in State Market Committees and for Computerization of All Market Committees
other_conditions: Eligible entities are Market Committees of any area within Gujarat.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50% (maximum ₹2  lakh) of costs for establishing farmer support centers and up to 90% (maximum ₹2  lakh) for computerising market committees (hardware/software) for K and D category committees.
